title: The State of AI Ethics Report, Volume 6

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing content moderation flags on social media platforms, statistical analysis of mortgage approval datasets while controlling for financial factors, and evaluating the filtering of ethnicity-specific dialects in large NLP training datasets.
Comparing search result rankings and recommendations by using gender-neutral search terms and checking for the presence and ordering of gendered terms in the returned results.
Analyzing large-scale language model training datasets (such as the C4 dataset) to measure the aggressive filtering and exclusion of non-offensive content related to LGBTQ+ communities.

Testing AI automated interview tools with non-target languages (e.g., reading German to test an English tool) to evaluate scoring validity, and examining the exclusion of colloquial minority dialects in NLP datasets.
Evaluating mortgage-approval algorithms by comparing approval and rejection rates across different income brackets, debt levels, and credit history availability.
